status: confirmed-static deterministic component false-negative candidate; runtime and overall reward untested
contract: Instruction requires a readable metric table in a DOCX committee memo and specific financial figures, with no requirement to group thousands with commas. The LLM final-response rubric accepts equivalent wording and reasonable numeric formatting, whereas the DOCX rule requires particular textual formatting for positive amounts.
static_mechanism: _text extracts literal DOCX paragraph and table-cell text. _money formats abs(value) with Python's comma grouping and searches for that substring or a dollar-prefixed version. For positive 184672.54 and 162826.17, it does not recognize 184672.54, $184672.54, 162826.17, or $162826.17 if no grouped version occurs elsewhere. For negative -21846.37, it additionally recognizes ungrouped (21846.37), but not an ungrouped bare or minus-prefixed value. check_memo_core_metrics uses _money for both positive amounts. check_memo_cross_source_control reuses it for corrected transfer amount. No normalization appears between DOCX extraction and rule invocation in the shared sidecar verifier path.
paired_probe: On amd-tw-verification, create two otherwise byte-identical DOCX memos with one metric table. Include 24 reviewed, 9 transfer-rule, 7 affected, and a fixed negative '(21,846.37)' plus 'decrease'. In A, use 184,672.54 and 162,826.17 in every occurrence; in B use 184672.54 and 162826.17 in every occurrence. Keep the run/denominator/action wording constant. Invoke only the extracted check_memo_core_metrics and check_memo_cross_source_control in a disposable workspace, capture per-rule score and detail, and confirm DOCX extracted text. Do not call an external judge.
expected_component_result: Under this code and controlled text, A passes both money-sensitive rule items and B fails both; the cause is only positive numeric grouping. A negative-only variant with '(21846.37)' should remain accepted by _money to confirm the branch's special case.
overall_reward_limit: This is a two-rule component result, not a full reward claim. The metadata has eight non-gate items of default weight 1 (four rule, four LLM), so if all other scores remain equal and these two rules alone flip from 1 to 0, the sidecar raw weighted score differs by 2/8=0.25. The actual full verifier branch, source integrity, external LLM verdicts, controller binarization and trainer effects are not established by this probe.
alternative_explanation: An author may have intended a currency style guide, but the task instruction does not specify one and the final-response rubric explicitly accepts reasonable numeric formatting. The DOCX table's lack of grouping is still legible and numerically unambiguous.
